meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Use the public `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, worktree comments, and the browser embedded inside the Orca app. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "Orca browser", or "control the browser inside Orca". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches Orca-managed state. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行操控开发工作区与终端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 Orca 管理多个开发工作区并经常切换
copy.tagline_en: Control dev workspaces and terminals from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Orca to manage multiple dev worktrees and switch often

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 `orca` 命令行操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、仓库、自动化、工作树评论和内置浏览器;执行前会先加载该 CLI 的版本匹配指南。
howto.when: 当你说出 “$orca-cli”、“use orca cli”、“Orca worktree” 等关键词,或要求操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、浏览器等时触发。

say.text: 用 orca cli 列出所有工作树
say.note: 会列出 Orca 管理的工作树。

say.text: 把当前任务完整移交给另一个 agent
say.note: 触发 full handoff 流程。

say.text: 在 Orca 内置浏览器中打开 https://example.com
say.note: 会通过 orca 控制内置浏览器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repositories, automations, worktree comments, and the embedded browser, and loads the version-matched guide before running commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", or asks to operate Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, or the browser.

say_en.text: Use orca cli to list all current worktrees.
Hand off the current task fully to another agent.
Open https://example.com in the Orca embedded browser.
say_en.note: Controls the built-in browser via orca.
